summary:
Comprehensive architectural and implementation plan for the portfolio restructuring:
1. Restructuring navigation to 4 bookmark tabs (Home, About, Works, Contact).
2. Works redesign: Migrating the fantasy clipboard from the provided zip into an animated React component featuring scattered background entrance settling into exact HTML positions, front paper with 'Projects' title and 6 project items, tech stack on the small note, and live photo preview on the picture frame.
3. Page 2 redesign into a vintage typewriter contact desk with message dispatch and social/comms dossier links.
